text:
Based on the documentation, when `provider: auto` is set, Hermes automatically prioritizes remote API keys found in your environment over local endpoints.

To prevent Hermes from routing to OpenRouter and force it to use your local setup:

* Change your provider setting from `provider: auto` to **`provider: custom`** in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`.
* Set your local endpoint explicitly via `base_url` (e.g., `base_url: http://localhost:11434` or your local llama.cpp server URL).

*(Note: Automatic complexity routing is unsupported by design, so explicit provider/model configuration is required when mixing local endpoints with remote API keys).*
